skill.name: firecrawl-scraper
skill.description: Use Firecrawl to extract web content, capture screenshots, parse PDFs, and crawl websites.
skill.summary: Guide Firecrawl-based scraping, crawling, screenshots, and PDF parsing.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: I found no executable code or prompt injection instructions in SKILL.md. Both static findings are documentation patterns: a manual installation command and a GitHub examples link, not runtime command execution or data exfiltration.

finding_verdicts.reason: The matched lines are a fenced Installation example showing npx skills add for manual setup. The skill does not execute the command automatically or interpolate user input.
The URL is a GitHub link for examples at line 28, not code that sends data over the network. No outbound request or credential transfer exists in the skill content.

content.value_statement: Manual web extraction is slow and inconsistent for complex sites. This skill guides Firecrawl scraping, crawling, screenshots, and PDF parsing from Claude, Codex, or Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Guides deep content extraction from web pages using Firecrawl.
Helps plan page interactions such as clicking and scrolling.
Supports screenshot and PDF parsing workflows.
Explains batch scraping for multiple URLs.
Reminds users to configure Firecrawl API keys with environment variables.
limitations: Requires a working Firecrawl API key and account access.
Does not include executable scraper code in this skill file.
Results depend on target site permissions, availability, and bot controls.
Users must verify legal, privacy, and terms-of-service requirements.

use_cases.title: Collect Competitor Page Content
use_cases.description: Extract visible page text and screenshots from public competitor pages for structured comparison.

use_cases.title: Build Research Datasets
use_cases.description: Crawl a list of public URLs and prepare page content for analysis or summarization.

use_cases.title: Parse Web PDFs
use_cases.description: Use Firecrawl to extract text from PDFs linked on public websites.

prompt_templates.title: Scrape One Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one public URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the firecrawl-scraper skill to extract the main content from this public URL: [URL]. Return the title, summary, key points, and any links that matter.

prompt_templates.title: Capture a Screenshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl guidance to capture a screenshot of [URL]. Note the viewport, page state, and any interaction needed before capture.

prompt_templates.title: Crawl Multiple URLs
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Firecrawl batch scrape for these URLs: [URL list]. Deduplicate pages, extract main content, and summarize patterns across the results.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Interactive Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Firecrawl workflow for [URL] that scrolls, clicks required public controls, captures screenshots, and extracts text from linked PDFs.

output_examples.input: Scrape a product documentation page and summarize it.
output_examples.output: The result includes the page title, a concise summary, important sections, extracted links, and notes about missing or blocked content.

output_examples.input: Crawl five public blog posts about one product.
output_examples.output: The result groups repeated themes, lists unique claims, identifies source pages, and flags pages that need manual review.

output_examples.input: Extract text from a public PDF linked on a website.
output_examples.output: The result provides the document title, extracted sections, important tables described in text, and any pages with poor extraction quality.

best_practices: Store Firecrawl API keys in environment variables, not prompts or files.
Start with one URL before running a larger crawl.
Respect site terms, rate limits, robots rules, and privacy constraints.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to bypass login walls, paywalls, or access controls.
Do not run broad crawls without rate limits and clear scope.
Do not treat extracted content as accurate without source review.

faq.question: Does this skill include scraper code?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for using Firecrawl workflows inside supported AI tools.

faq.question: Do I need a Firecrawl API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Firecrawl access and API credentials are required for actual scraping tasks.

faq.question: Can it parse PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes PDF parsing as a supported Firecrawl workflow.

faq.question: Can it handle page interactions?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill mentions interactions such as clicking and scrolling when a page requires them.

faq.question: Is it safe for private websites?
faq.answer: Use it only where you have permission. Do not extract private or restricted content without authorization.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
